summary: Unconditional game-state change dispatch chain. Sets the player vehicle index to a2, refreshes the camera target and camera view for the change, dispatches conditional audio/virtual state, emits an AI out-of-track event for the new target, then calls the completion handler sub_4D8760(1, 0) and returns its result. No guards; every step runs in sequence.

operations.description: Set the player vehicle index to a2 (the newly selected vehicle).
Update the camera target to the player on player change, using the this context.
Assign the camera view based on this context and the new target a2.
Dispatch conditional audio/virtual state for the player-change context.
Trigger the AI out-of-track event for the new vehicle a2.
Call the completion handler sub_4D8760 with constant arguments (1, 0).
Return the result of the completion handler sub_4D8760(1, 0).
